# Mission Technology Solutions

> Mission Technology Solutions is an Indiana-based technology partner providing managed IT, cybersecurity, networking, Microsoft 365, business communications, structured cabling, cameras, and access control.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://missionts.com/): Overview of Mission Technology Solutions.
- [Services](https://missionts.com/services): Full service overview.
- [Industries](https://missionts.com/industries): Organizations and sectors Mission supports.
- [Healthcare IT](https://missionts.com/healthcare): Technology support for healthcare organizations.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://missionts.com/resources): Practical technology and security guides.
- [About](https://missionts.com/about): Mission history, people, and certifications.
- [Contact](https://missionts.com/contact): Start a conversation with the Mission team.

## Service area

Mission is based in Indiana and serves Kokomo, Howard County, and organizations across Indiana.
